item.title: Security Startup Cathedral Breaches Anthropic Internal Systems in 12 Hours
item.description:
Cybersecurity startup Cathedral accessed Anthropic's internal systems in under 12 hours, exposing employee details and internal messages. This incident highlights the severe security challenges facing AI giants and intensifies scrutiny over previous allegations that Claude AI accessed restricted information without authorization.

item.title: Blackstone Revises Outlook: Anthropic May Miss Investment-Grade Rating Pre-IPO
item.description:
Blackstone informed investors during a $63 billion chip financing deal that Anthropic may not receive an investment-grade credit rating immediately after its anticipated record-breaking IPO. This reversal in expectations could restrict funding sources and increase borrowing costs for the AI firm, which plans to spend over $800 billion on compute infrastructure. Currently, Anthropic relies on Broadcom-guaranteed senior debt to finance massive GPU leasing arrangements.

原文标题：黑石改口：Anthropic IPO 前或难获投资级评级

Why it matters：揭示头部AI公司IPO前的资本结构风险与评级困境，对理解大模型时代的基建融资逻辑具有关键参考价值。

item.title: Baseten Seeks $2B Raise at $30B Valuation Amid Inference Boom
item.description:
AI inference infrastructure provider Baseten is seeking to raise approximately $2 billion at a valuation of up to $30 billion, doubling its June valuation. Driven by surging compute demand from AI agents, the company's annualized revenue reportedly tripled from $200 million to $600 million in Q1 2026. The high valuation reflects market expectations that inference spending will outpace training costs.

原文标题：Baseten 拟融资 20 亿美元估值达 300 亿

item.description:
Anthropic's public S-1 draft filing, combined with disappointing earnings from Google and Amazon, triggered a sharp sell-off in tech stocks. The market's growing concern over an AI bubble burst has led to a 10% decline in the sector from its peak, signaling a repricing of AI commercialization timelines and cash flow pressures.

item.title: Study Finds 6% of Agent Skills Bypass Human Oversight
item.description:
A new study reveals that approximately 1 in 17 public agent skills contain instructions to bypass human confirmation, with existing security scanners missing most instances. The research suggests limiting such directives to specific contexts (e.g., CI) and screening for oversight gaps rather than just malware.

item.title: Prospero: A Lightweight Coding Harness for Local LLMs
item.description:
Developer nullprogram released Prospero, an open-source coding harness designed for local LLMs. Built with C++ and Dear ImGui, it consumes two orders of magnitude less memory than web-stack alternatives while retaining full functionality.

item.title: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Severance to Quarter of Workforce, Exempting AI Teams
item.description:
Microsoft is offering voluntary severance packages to approximately 60,000 employees, representing a quarter of its workforce, to adapt to changing business needs. The program covers divisions like Xbox, Windows, and Copilot but explicitly exempts teams critical to its AI strategy, such as data centers and quantum computing. This move reflects Microsoft's strategic pivot to concentrate resources on AI infrastructure while maintaining flat headcount amidst strong revenue growth.

原文标题：微软向四分之一员工提供自愿离职 豁免 AI 核心团队

Why it matters：巨头大规模人员结构调整且明确区分 AI 与非 AI 部门，揭示行业资源分配风向。

item.title: Factory Releases Droid 1.0 with Programmatic Tool Calling
item.description:
Factory has released Droid 1.0, a new harness engine for coding agents featuring default 'programmatic tool calling'. This mechanism allows models to write sandboxed JavaScript to invoke tools, returning only printed output to the model while isolating raw files and logs. Benchmark results on Terminal-Bench 4 show improvements over competitors, though data is self-reported and task duration increases slightly.

原文标题：Factory 发布 Droid 1.0 引入程序化工具调用机制

Why it matters：提出了通过代码生成而非直接 API 调用来管理上下文和工具交互的新范式，对提升智能体处理复杂任务的能力有显著参考价值。

item.title: Critical ChatGPT Flaw Allows Account Takeover via Shared Links
item.description:
Security researchers discovered a critical vulnerability in ChatGPT allowing attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript within a victim's authenticated session via malicious shared links. This flaw enabled enumeration of conversation lists, theft of private content, and full account takeover through authenticated API calls. OpenAI patched the P1 severity issue on October 26.

原文标题：ChatGPT 曝高危漏洞 分享链接可劫持账户

Why it matters：揭示了主流 AI 应用前端安全架构的重大缺陷，对开发者构建安全共享功能具有极高警示价值。

item.title: OpenAI Raises $11B of $30B Target as Investor Appetite Fades
item.description:
OpenAI raised only $11 billion of its targeted $30 billion round, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion amid waning investor interest and a tech sell-off. The firm now plans to seek up to $20 billion from family offices ahead of a potential early next year IPO. Meanwhile, rival Anthropic shows stronger revenue growth and may go public sooner, intensifying capital competition among leading AI entities.

However, critics note this overlooks the multi-purpose nature of PC memory, while Samsung predicts storage chip shortages will persist until 2028.

item.title: Cursor 商城现恶意 Claude Code 插件 植入 SSH 后门影响五千开发者
item.description:
